desc:
Serve Westport County.

Patrol is an emergency services roleplay set in West Holbrook, a hand-built city in the State of Aurelo.

• Choose your service: West Holbrook Police, the Westport County Sheriff, EMS, or life as a civilian.
• Take calls from dispatch, follow the GPS to the scene and handle it your way.
• Run names, plates and warrants on the computer in your patrol car.
• Talk to anyone you meet: ask questions, check ID, search, detain and arrest, then book them in at the station.
• As a medic, check patients over and treat them with a hands-on medical system.
• Earn XP, pass promotion exams and climb the ranks. Join units such as Metro, Traffic and Detectives.
• Double crew with a partner, or train a new recruit.
• Explore a detailed map of homes, shops, stations and a hospital you can walk into, with a day and night cycle and weather.

Patrol is in active development and updated often.
